fusions.name: Belfry Shriek
fusions.desc: Shrieks in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving everything caught [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Tether
fusions.desc: A dart of darkness deals 4 damage and heals you for 25% of it, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mobbing Colony
fusions.desc: Looses a colony of bats for 12 seconds. Every second it bites an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding on the Held
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
